CITY OF ALHAMBRA HISTORIC PRESERVATION COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Special Meeting
  December 4, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  6:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Michelson, Amaro

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director of Community Development; Maia
  McCurley, Principal Planner; Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Greg
  Murphy, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Amaro

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – SEPTEMBER 25, 2024 (6:01 P.M.)
  •  Request: This is a request for the Historic Preservation
  Commission to approve the Minutes of the September 25, 2024,
  Regular Meeting of the Alhambra Historical Preservation
  Committee meeting.
  •  Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the September 25, 2024, Regular
  Meeting of the Alhambra Historic Preservation Commission
  meeting.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Littlefield, Seconded by Commissioner
  Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of
  the discussion is available here:
  https://www.cityofalhambra.org/DocumentCenter/View/5979/HPC-Meeting---
  December-4-2024-Audio

  1
  12/4/2024
 E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DRAFT HISTORIC PRESERVATION ORDINANCE (6:02 P.M.)
  •  This is a presentation on the feedback and community input
  received since the release of the Draft Historic Preservation
  Ordinance; an overview of the Commissioner’s questions
  regarding the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance and
  associated discussion items; and the options for how to proceed
  with the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Historic
  Preservation Commission receive the presentation on the Draft
  Historic Preservation Ordinance; receive public comment;
  consider, discuss, and deliberate on the options for the Draft
  Historic Preservation Ordinance; and then provide direction on
  how to proceed with the Draft Historic Preservation Ordinance.
  •  The City’s consultant, Historic Resources Group (HRG), and
  sub-consultant, Architectural Resources Group (ARG),
  provided the presentation.

  •  Recess at 8:22 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 8:30 P.M.

  •  The public comment portion of the Discussion Item was
  opened and closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Todd Jones
  2.) Andrew Salimian
  3.) Veronica Alvarez
  4.) Frank Ortiz
  5.) Olga Michaels
  6.) Krishna Patel (Representing Dhirajlal N. Desai)
  7.) Lewis McCammon
  8.) Jennifer Ng
  9.) Oscar Amaro

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to proceed with Option Number 2 (Revised Draft Historic
  Preservation Ordinance).
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ng, Seconded by Vice President
  Michelson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Chen, Littlefield, Ng, Michelson, Amaro
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of
  the discussion is available here:

F.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Jennifer Ng suggested to have another special meeting before the next regular
  meeting. She requested to update the website to show the eighth district.
  Thanked staff for the packet and Commissioners for their time putting their
  questions together. (9:48 P.M.)

  •  Chris Olson commented the Historical Society Museum will have a physical copy
  of the PowerPoint presentation and a copy of all materials presented by HRG, as
  they do of the survey that was done. (9:50 P.M.)

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recording of
  the discussion is available here:
  https://www.cityofalhambra.org/DocumentCenter/View/5979/HPC-Meeting---
  December-4-2024-Audio

G.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 9:53 P.M. to
  Wednesday, January 22, 2025, at 6:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Joyce Amaro
  President
